hook: Prompt your coding agent without making a sound.
hookText: Silent lip dictation on a Mac

beats.say: A new Claude Code plugin reads your lips through the webcam. The lip reading model runs locally on Apple Silicon, so no audio is recorded and no video leaves the Mac.
It uses Auto AVSR's visual model, with two hundred fifty million parameters trained on three thousand two hundred ninety one hours of video.
Accuracy is modest, with a twenty point three percent word error rate on its benchmark, so you can train it on your own lips with about one hundred phrases.
